$comment: Curated CLI stack presets. Each pick's slug must exist in data/clis.json (enforced by validate-data.mjs). Roles describe why the tool is in the stack. Contributor-editable.

stacks.name: Frontend Development
stacks.description: Design handoff, docs diagrams, and headless-browser inspection for building and debugging web UIs.
stacks.note: The directory is light on build/lint/test-runner CLIs — pair this with your framework's own tooling.

picks.role: Design source of truth — export assets and specs for implementation
Architecture and flow diagrams for feature planning
Diagrams-as-text committed alongside the code
Drive a real Chrome tab to inspect the rendered DOM
Scriptable headless browsing for smoke checks

stacks.name: Backend Development
stacks.description: Mock upstream services, manage processes, clean data, and back features with a headless CMS and a vector store.

picks.role: Stub and record HTTP dependencies during development and tests
Run and reload Node services with logs and metrics
Interactive cleaning and reshaping of messy source data
Vector storage for search and retrieval features
Structured content / headless CMS for content-driven APIs

stacks.name: DevOps
stacks.description: Access control, deployments, error monitoring, process supervision, secrets, and network filtering.

picks.role: Bastion host — manage assets, sessions, and audit logs
Build and release pipelines with rollbacks
Error and performance monitoring across services
Process manager for long-running Node workloads
Inject secrets into scripts and CI without plaintext
DNS-level filtering and network infrastructure control

stacks.name: Cloud
stacks.description: Object storage, deployment automation, credential handling, and observability for cloud-hosted apps.
stacks.note: Coverage is partial — bring your provider's own CLI (aws / gcloud / az) alongside these.

picks.role: S3-compatible object storage management
Automated deploys to cloud hosts
Cloud credentials and API keys on demand
Production error and release health tracking

stacks.name: AI Engineering
stacks.description: Local model serving, a vector database for RAG, image pipelines, and workflow orchestration for LLM apps.

picks.role: Serve local LLMs over an HTTP API for offline development
Vector database for embeddings and retrieval
Node-based diffusion pipelines for image generation
Design and run LLM application workflows
Chat front-end over local or remote models
Glue models, tools and data sources into automations

stacks.name: Cybersecurity
stacks.description: OSINT monitoring, anti-detection browsing, secret management, and network-level filtering.
stacks.note: A small slice — this directory is not security-focused. Treat it as a starting point, not a toolkit.

picks.role: Monitor sources for OSINT signals and changes
Fingerprint-resistant browser automation for research
Vault automation and least-privilege secret access
Inspect and filter DNS traffic on a network

stacks.name: Data Engineering
stacks.description: Data cleaning, a vector store, geospatial processing, reporting, and pipeline orchestration.

picks.role: Clean, cluster and transform tabular data with an undo history
Store and query vector embeddings
Batch geospatial processing and map production
Programmatic clinical / statistical reporting
Schedule and connect extract-transform-load steps
